youtube.baslik: Does a normal caloric test rule out vestibular neuritis? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The superior division of the vestibular nerve carries the lateral and anterior canals and the utricle; the inferior division carries the posterior canal and most of the saccule. The caloric test assesses the lateral canal, so it can stay normal with inferior involvement, while video head impulse testing shows low posterior canal gain and the cervical VEMP is affected. That is why the test battery is interpreted together.

bilgiler: The superior division is most often involved; calorics show it.
With inferior involvement, the caloric test can stay normal.
Posterior canal vHIT and cVEMP reveal it.

cumleler: Does a normal caloric test rule out vestibular neuritis?
The superior division carries the lateral and anterior canals and utricle.
The inferior division carries the posterior canal and most of the saccule.
Calorics test the lateral canal, so inferior involvement can look normal.
On video head impulse testing, posterior canal gain drops; cVEMP is affected.
Looking only at calorics can miss it; read the battery together.
